augments.text: Your champions gain @MaxHealthPerInterest@ permanent max health per interest you earn. Gain @InstantGold@ gold now.

augments.name: Radiant Relics
augments.text: Choose 1 of 5 Radiant Items. Gain a Magnetic Remover.

augments.name: Epoch+
augments.text: Now, and at the start of every stage, gain @EpochPlusXP@ XP and @EpochPlusRerolls@ free rerolls.

augments.name: U.R.F
augments.text: Gain a Spatula. Champions holding Spatula or Frying Pan items gain @AS*100@% Attack Speed and @ManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

augments.name: Luxury Subscription
augments.text: Gain a package containing a @1StarCost@-cost champion, a 2-star @2StarCost@-cost champion, and @Gold@ gold.At the start of the next @Stages@ stages, gain the package again.

augments.name: Promised Protection
augments.text: Gain a Protector's Vow. Protector's Vow grants its holder @IncomingManaIncreasePercentage*100@% additional Mana from all sources and @FlatHP@ max Health.

augments.name: Jeweled Lotus II
augments.text: Your team gains @CritChance_II@% Critical Strike Chance, @CritDamage_II@% Critical Strike Damage, and Precision.Precision: Ability damage can critically strike. Additional Precision grants 10% Critical Strike Damage.

augments.name: Twin Guardians
augments.text: If you have exactly @NumMultiples@ allies in your first row, grant them @BonusHealth@ Health, @ArmorInstant@ Armor, and @MagicResistInstant@ Magic Resist.

augments.name: Explosive Growth
augments.text: Now and at the start of the next @Rounds@ rounds, gain @XPPerRound@ XP.

augments.name: Forged In Strength
augments.text: Gain @InitialArtifacts@ random Artifact. When you drop below @Health@ Health, gain @MoreArtifacts@ more random Artifact, @MoreCompletedItems@ random completed item, and @MoreComponents@ random component.Remix Rumble Championship, 2023

augments.name: Advanced Loan
augments.text: Gain @GoldInstantBasic@ Gold. Your next augment is one tier lower.

augments.name: Electrocharge II
augments.text: Every @ProcAttackCount@ attacks an ally takes, they deal @DamageII@-@DamageII_4@ (based on current Stage) magic damage to nearby enemies (@Cooldown@ second cooldown).

augments.name: Lucky Gloves+
augments.text: Thief's Gloves will always give your champions ideal items. Gain @StartSparringGlovesAmount@ Sparring Gloves now, then another after @CombatsUntilNextRewardPlus@ player combats.

augments.name: Trade Sector+
augments.text: Gain a free Shop reroll every round. Gain @NumGoldPlus@ gold.

augments.name: Arcane Viktor-y
augments.text: After @InitialStunDelayInSeconds@ seconds of combat, stun the enemy team for @StunDuration@ seconds. Repeat this after @RepeatStunDelayInSeconds@ seconds of combat.TFT Macao Open, 2024

augments.name: Glass Cannon I
augments.text: Allies that start combat in the back row begin combat at @StartingHP*100@% Health but gain @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp.

augments.name: Backup Bows
augments.text: Gain a Recurve Bow. After your champions attack @AttackCount@ times, get @NumBows@ more.

augments.name: Verticality III
augments.text: Champions gain @ADAP*100@% Attack Damage, @ADAP*100@% Ability Power, @resists@ Armor, and @resists@ Magic Resist for each ally that shares a trait with them.

augments.name: Dark Ritual
augments.text: Converting Coven Essence to rewards grants Coven champions Ability Power instead of loot. Gain a Camille, an Elise, and a Caitlyn.

augments.name: Crafted Crafting
augments.text: Whenever you craft a completed item, gain @NumFreeRerolls@ rerolls.

augments.name: Champ Delivery+
augments.text: Gain @NumInitialChamps@ @ChampCost@-cost champions. After @Delay@ rounds, gain @NumDelayedChamps@ more.

augments.name: Spreading Roots
augments.text: Gain @EmblemAmount@ random Emblems and @GoldAmount@ gold.

augments.name: Slice of Life
augments.text: Twice per stage, gain a random champion. Its cost increases by Stage. This effect ends after receiving @NumOfMaxCosts@ @MaxChampCost@-cost champion.

augments.name: Silver Destiny
augments.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.

augments.name: Clockwork Accelerator
augments.text: Your team gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed every @FrequencySeconds@ seconds in combat.

augments.name: Small Grab Bag
augments.text: Gain @NumberOfComponents@ random item components.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II++
augments.text: Gain @AmountOfGlovesAtStartIIPlusPlus@ Thief's Gloves. After @CombatsUntilNextRewardIIPlusPlus@ player combats, gain another.

augments.name: Blossom's Call
augments.text: When you buy a Wisp, gain a random Blossom champion based on the Wisp's cost. Gain a Yunara, a Yorick, and a Karma.

augments.name: Frontline Foundation
augments.text: Gain a 2-star 1-cost Tank champion and an Emblem that matches their class.

augments.name: Wand Overflow
augments.text: Gain @NumRods@ Needlessly Large Rods. Your Needlessly Large Rods grant +@AttackSpeedPerRod*100@% Attack Speed.

augments.name: Soul Awakening
augments.text: Combat start: Your team gains @CombatStartAdBoost*100@% Attack Damage and Ability Power per second for @NumRepeatsAfterInitialApplication@ seconds. At max stacks, deal @TrueDamage*100@% bonus true damage.

augments.name: Expedition
augments.text: At the start of every round, lose the champion in the rightmost bench slot. After losing @CashoutCost@ gold of champions in this way, gain a powerful reward. Gain a 3-cost champion now.

augments.name: Beast Within+
augments.text: Primal grants an additional Blessing. Gain a Vi and a Sivir.

augments.name: Flame On
augments.text: The Inferno champion that dealt the most damage last combat is On Fire, gaining @AS*100@% Attack Speed. Gain a Varus and an Akali.

augments.name: Component Quest
augments.text: Gain a random component and @NumGold@ gold. The next 7 times you win a player combat, gain a different random component. Afterwards, gain @CompletionGold@ gold.

augments.name: Pandora's Items III
augments.text: Round start: items on your bench are randomized. Gain @NumberOfRadiantItemsIII@ Radiant item.

augments.name: Money Hungry
augments.text: Gain @InitialGold@ gold now, then @GoldPerStage@ gold at the start of every stage. Picking up gold makes your Tactician larger.

augments.name: Kick Start
augments.text: Gain a random @StarLevel@-star @ChampCost@-cost champion and @NumGold@ gold.

augments.name: Caretaker's Favor
augments.text: Gain a component anvil when you reach level 5, 6, 7, and 8.Component anvils offer 4 choices.

augments.name: Wisp Rebate+
augments.text: Each time you purchase a Wisp, gain @Gold@ gold. Gain @StartingGold@ gold now.

augments.name: Seraphim's Staff
augments.text: Gain an Archangel's Staff. Archangel's Staff grants @ManaPerSecond@ additional Mana Regen if its holder has @APThreshold*100@% or more Ability Power.

augments.name: Staffsmith
augments.text: Gain  @ItemQuantity@ random completed items that build from Needlessly Large Rod.

augments.name: Residual Magic
augments.text: Your team gains @InitialHealth@ Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by @HealthPerSprite@.

augments.name: Celestial Blessing II
augments.text: Your team gains @OmnivampII*100@% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to @ShieldMaxII@ Health.

augments.name: Radiant Rascal
augments.text: Gain a Radiant Thief's Gloves item. This equips 2 random Radiant items every round.

augments.name: Celestial Blessing III
augments.text: Your team gains @OmnivampIII*100@% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to @ShieldMaxIII@ Health.

augments.name: Exclusive Customization
augments.text: Gain a Lucky Item Chest, a Magnetic Remover and @Gold@ gold.

augments.name: Deadlier Blades
augments.text: Gain a Deathblade. Deathblades permanently gain @AttackDamagePercent*100@% Attack Damage whenever their holders score a takedown.

augments.name: Residual Magic +
augments.text: Your team gains @InitialHealth@ Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by @HealthPerSprite@.

augments.name: Flexible
augments.text: Gain 1 random Emblem. At the start of every Stage, gain a random Emblem. Your team gains @Health@ Health for each Emblem they are holding.

augments.name: Flowing Tears
augments.text: Gain a Tear of the Goddess. After your champions spend @CompletionManaRequired@ Mana, gain @CompletionNumRewards@ more.

augments.name: Bodyguard Training
augments.text: Allies gain @ArmorBonus@ Armor and Magic Resist, increased by @PlayerLevelBonus@ per player level.Gizmos & Gadgets Championship, 2022

augments.name: Celestial Blessing I
augments.text: Your team gains @OmnivampI*100@% Omnivamp. Excess healing is converted to a shield up to @ShieldMaxI@ Health.

augments.name: Heart of Steel
augments.text: Gain a Steadfast Heart. Every @SurvivePeriodInSeconds@ seconds of combat its holder survives, Steadfast Heart gains additional @MaxHealthGain@ permanent max Health.

augments.name: Salvage Bin+
augments.text: Gain 1 random completed item now, and 1 component after @RoundsPlus@ player combats. Selling champions breaks completed items into components (excluding Tactician's items and Emblems).

augments.name: The Golden Egg
augments.text: Gain a golden egg that hatches in @Rounds@ turns for a huge amount of loot. Winning player combat speeds up the hatch timer by an extra turn.

augments.name: Comeback Story
augments.text: Your team gains @HPPerMissingHP@ Health and @ASMultiplyPerMissingHP*100@% Attack Speed per missing player Health.

augments.name: Invested++
augments.text: Gain 45 gold. At the start of each round, gain 1 Shop reroll for every 10 gold above 50 (max 80 gold).

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny
augments.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and @Gold@ gold.

augments.name: Cooking Pot
augments.text: At the start of each turn, all allies holding a Frying Pan or Spatula item grant the nearest champion @HealthIncrease@ permanent Health. Gain a Frying Pan.

augments.name: Pandora's Bench
augments.text: At the start of every round, champions on the @NumBenchSlots@ rightmost bench slots transform into random champions of the same cost. Gain @GoldGain@ gold.

augments.name: Heroic Grab Bag++
augments.text: Gain 2 Lesser Champion Duplicators. Gain @Gold@ gold.

augments.name: Weight The Worth
augments.text: The first time you 3-star a champion, gain a copy of them each round for the rest of the game. 3-starring the same champion again grants additional copies. Gain a Lesser Champion Duplicator and a Tiny Champion Duplicator.

augments.name: Booster Pack++
augments.text: Gain @CombinedChampsValuePlusPlus@ gold of random champions. (At least one @GuaranteedChampValuePlusPlus@-cost guaranteed!)

augments.name: Commerce Core
augments.text: Gain @InitRerolls@ free Shop rerolls now and @PerTurnRerolls@ every round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Carve a Path
augments.text: Gain a B.F. Sword. After your champions deal @PhysicalDamageUntilCompletion@ physical damage, gain @NumCompletionRewards@ more.

augments.name: Cognitive Tax
augments.text: Gain @NumGold@ gold and @NumXp@ XP.

augments.name: Group Hug II
augments.text: Combat start: Champions grant other adjacent champions @Armor_Gold@ Armor and Magic Resist. This effect stacks.

augments.name: Infinity Protection
augments.text: Gain @GoldAmount@ gold now. On Stage @UnlockStage@-@UnlockRound@, gain an Infinity Force. Infinity Force gives allies in the same row a @HealthPercent*100@% Health shield.Monsters Attack Championship, 2023

augments.name: Silver Destiny++
augments.text: Gain a random Silver Augment and @Gold@ gold.

augments.name: One Buff Two Buff
augments.text: Gain a Red Buff, a Blue Buff, and a Champion Duplicator.

augments.name: Branching Out
augments.text: Gain a random Emblem.

augments.name: Called Shot
augments.text: Set your win streak to +@WinStreakCount@. Gain @Gold@ gold.

augments.name: Band of Thieves II+
augments.text: Gain @AmountOfGlovesAtStartIIPlus@ Thief's Gloves. After @CombatsUntilNextRewardIIPlus@ player combats, gain another.

augments.name: The Tower
augments.text: Gain a giant Training Dummy. Every @TowerAttackInterval@ seconds, it zaps the @TowerNumTargets@ nearest enemies dealing @MaxHealthDamageMultiplier*100@% max Health true damage.

augments.name: Birthday Present
augments.text: Gain a 2-star champion and @Gold@ gold each time you level up. The champion's cost tier is your level minus @LevelDiff@ (max: @MaxTier@-cost).

augments.name: Find Your Center
augments.text: Your champion that starts combat in the center of the front row gains @DamageAmpPercent*100@% Damage Amp and @MaxHealthMultiplier*100@% max Health.

augments.name: Small Furry Friend
augments.text: While Sprykin is active, gain a second BFF summon that is @Effectiveness_DoesntIncludeSummonSpell*100@% as powerful. Gain a Teemo, a Veigar, and a Kobuko.

augments.name: Healing Orbs II
augments.text: When an enemy dies, a nearby ally is healed for @HealthFromHealingOrbGold@ Health.

augments.name: NO SCOUT NO PIVOT
augments.text: Champions that fight in player combat cannot be benched or sold. Your team gains @PostCombatHealthBoost*100@% Health, and @PostCombatApBoost*100@% Attack Damage and Ability Power after player combat.

augments.name: Golden Gamble++
augments.text: Gain @Gold@ gold and flip a coin. If heads, gain a Radiant Lucky Item Chest. If tails, gain @NumAnvils@ Completed Item anvils.

augments.name: Hard Bargain
augments.text: You cannot choose your Carousel rewards. Gain an additional @PlayerHealth@ player health and @Gold@ gold each carousel round.When you do not pick a Carousel Reward, you are given an unpicked champion and the item it carries.

augments.name: Bronze For Life I
augments.text: Your team gains @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp for each Bronze-tier trait.

augments.name: Giant and Mighty
augments.text: Your team becomes large, gaining @FlatHealth@ Health and @HealthMultiplier*100@% max Health.

augments.name: Residual Magic ++
augments.text: Your team gains @InitialHealth@ Health. Each time you purchase a Wisp, increase this by @HealthPerSprite@.

augments.name: Item Grab Bag I
augments.text: Gain 1 random completed item.

augments.name: Future Focused
augments.text: Your Tactician loses @HealthLoss@ Health, but after @NumRounds@ player combats, gain @NumChampions@ 4-cost champions and @RewardGold@ gold.

augments.name: Baron's Lair
augments.text: Gain a random Tank item. After @StartSeconds@ seconds of combat, your team gains @Stats*100@% bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power every second for the rest of combat.TFT Paris Open, 2025

augments.name: Good For Something I
augments.text: Champions that aren't holding items have a @ChangeDrop*100@% chance to drop @GoldReward@ gold on death.

augments.name: Spirit Of Redemption
augments.text: Gain a Spirit Visage. Every @TimeIntervalSeconds@ seconds, Spirit Visage heals allies within @HexRange@ hex for @PercentMissingHealth*100@% of their missing Health.

augments.name: Worth the Wait
augments.text: Gain a random 1-cost champion. Gain another copy of them at the start of each round for the rest of the game.

augments.name: Prismatic Destiny+
augments.text: Gain a random Prismatic Augment and @Gold@ gold.
